rules.title: Maximum amount, first loan
rules.base: The maximum amount for a first individual loan is GHS 5,000.

history.text: The maximum amount for a first individual loan is reduced from GHS 5,000 to GHS 3,500.
The maximum amount for a first individual loan is set at GHS 4,000. This circular supersedes Circular 2024/02 on this point.

questions.q: What is the maximum amount a first-time borrower can get on an individual loan?
A client wants GHS 4,500 as her first individual loan. Can I approve that?
What was the maximum first individual loan as of 15 January 2025?
What was the maximum first individual loan as of 10 January 2024?

rules.title: Maximum amount, repeat borrowers
rules.base: The maximum amount for an individual loan to a repeat borrower is GHS 20,000.

history.text: The maximum amount for an individual loan to a repeat borrower is raised from GHS 20,000 to GHS 25,000.

questions.q: What is the maximum individual loan for a repeat borrower?

rules.title: Maximum tenor
rules.base: The maximum tenor of an individual loan is 12 months.

questions.q: What is the longest repayment period we can give on an individual loan?

rules.title: Interest rate cap
rules.base: The interest rate on any loan shall not exceed 4.0% per month on a flat basis.

history.text: The maximum interest rate is reduced from 4.0% to 3.5% per month on a flat basis, in line with the regulator's guidance.
The maximum interest rate is reduced from 3.5% to 3.0% per month on a flat basis with effect from 1 January 2027.

questions.q: What is the maximum monthly interest rate we can charge today?
Is any change to the interest rate cap coming?

rules.title: Processing fee
rules.base: A processing fee of 1.5% of the principal is charged on every loan at disbursement.

questions.q: How much is the loan processing fee?

rules.title: Guarantors
rules.base: Every individual loan above GHS 2,000 requires two guarantors who are not members of the borrower's household.

history.text: The guarantor requirement now applies to every individual loan above GHS 1,500, reduced from GHS 2,000. Two guarantors are still required.

questions.q: From what loan size do we need two guarantors?
Can I accept just one guarantor for a client who has repaid three loans on time?

rules.title: Group size
rules.base: A solidarity group shall have a minimum of 5 and a maximum of 30 members.

questions.q: What is the minimum number of members in a solidarity group?

rules.title: First-cycle limit per member
rules.base: In the first cycle of a group loan, each member may borrow up to GHS 1,500.

history.text: The first-cycle limit per member in a group loan is raised from GHS 1,500 to GHS 2,000.

questions.q: How much can a member borrow in the first cycle of a group loan?

rules.title: Emergency loans
rules.base: An emergency loan shall not exceed GHS 1,000 and shall be repaid within 3 months.

questions.q: What are the maximum amount and the repayment period for an emergency loan?

rules.title: Compulsory savings
rules.base: A borrower must hold compulsory savings of 10% of the loan amount before disbursement.

history.text: Compulsory savings before disbursement are increased from 10% to 12% of the loan amount.

questions.q: What percentage of the loan must a borrower hold in compulsory savings before disbursement?

rules.title: Arrears notification
rules.base: When a loan is 14 days overdue, the loan officer shall notify the branch manager in writing.

history.text: The notification period is shortened from 14 days to 7 days overdue.

questions.q: After how many days overdue must the branch manager be notified?

rules.title: Restructuring
rules.base: A loan may be restructured once only, by an extension of up to 3 months, with the approval of the Head of Risk.

questions.q: Can a loan be restructured more than once?

rules.title: Cash disbursement limit
rules.base: Cash disbursements are limited to GHS 2,000 per transaction. Larger amounts shall be paid by mobile money or bank transfer.

history.text: The cash disbursement limit is reduced from GHS 2,000 to GHS 1,500 per transaction.

questions.q: What is the largest cash disbursement we can make in one transaction?

rules.title: Approval limits
rules.base: A branch manager may approve loans up to GHS 10,000. Loans above GHS 10,000 shall be referred to the Regional Credit Committee.

questions.q: Up to what amount can a branch manager approve a loan?

rules.title: Identification
rules.base: Every borrower shall present a Ghana Card or a valid voter identification card.

history.text: From 1 April 2025 only the Ghana Card is accepted as identification. Voter identification cards are no longer accepted.

questions.q: Can I accept a voter ID as identification for a new borrower?

rules.title: Prohibited activities
rules.base: Loans shall not be used to finance gambling, the wholesale of tobacco products, or the trade in firearms.

history.text: Trading in cryptocurrency is added to the list of activities that loans shall not finance under Section 2.3.1.

questions.q: Can we lend to a client who makes his living trading cryptocurrency?

rules.title: Cooling-off period
rules.base: A borrower may cancel a loan without penalty within 3 days of signing the loan agreement.

questions.q: How many days does a borrower have to cancel a loan after signing?

rules.title: Late fees
rules.base: A late fee of 0.5% per week is charged on the overdue amount. Total late fees shall not exceed 10% of the overdue amount.

history.text: The cap on total late fees is reduced from 10% to 5% of the overdue amount.

questions.q: What is the cap on total late fees?

rules.title: Age
rules.base: A borrower shall be at least 18 years old at application and no older than 65 years at the end of the loan term.

questions.q: What is the maximum age of a borrower at the end of the loan term?

rules.title: Time in business
rules.base: The borrower's business shall have been operating for at least 6 months before an individual loan is approved.

history.text: The minimum time in business for an individual loan is reduced from 6 months to 4 months.

questions.q: How long must a business have been operating before we can give an individual loan?

rules.title: Loan insurance
rules.base: A loan insurance premium of 1% of the principal is charged on every loan.

questions.q: How much is the loan insurance premium?

rules.title: Concurrent loans
rules.base: A member may hold at most one active individual loan and one active group loan at any time.

questions.q: Can a member have two individual loans at the same time?

rules.title: Repayments on public holidays
rules.base: A repayment falling due on a public holiday or a Sunday is due on the next business day.

questions.q: A repayment falls due on a public holiday. When is it due?

rules.title: Write-off
rules.base: A loan that is 180 days overdue may be written off with the approval of the Head of Risk.

history.text: The period before a loan may be written off is reduced from 180 days to 150 days overdue.

questions.q: After how many days overdue can a loan be written off?

rules.title: Retention of member files
rules.base: Member files shall be retained for 7 years after the loan is closed.

questions.q: How long must member files be kept after a loan is closed?
